hook.text: GitHub had never been profitable. Microsoft bought it for $7.5 billion in 2018. Developers panicked.

buildup.text: GitHub hosted 85 million repositories. Every open-source project and most enterprise codebases lived on the platform.

discovery.text: Microsoft wanted developer loyalty. Owning GitHub gave it influence over how 40 million developers build software.

twist.text: The community feared Microsoft would ruin GitHub. Instead, it kept it free, added features, and grew it to 100M+ users.

climax.text: GitHub Copilot, built on top of the platform, became a massive AI business. The acquisition's value keeps compounding.

punchline.text: Buy the developer platform, own the developer ecosystem.

quiz.question: Why did Microsoft acquire GitHub?
options: To gain influence over the global developer ecosystem
To build a social media platform
